subject: Renewal: capacity uplift, MSA clarifications, and evidence packet

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift + MSA clarifications

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As we discussed, your renewal is up for signature mid-April and the primary asks from Greenridge are: a 30% capacity uplift for Q3 (prefix KV cache workload), a 12-month term extension at the current effective rate, and a few MSA clarifications around data retention and audit access.

To keep momentum, could you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday so we can line up legal:
- Final seat/capacity numbers (expected tokens/day or monthly throughput)
- Whether you'd accept our standard 30-day audit notice for SOC2 evidence
- Any procurement PO/CLIN timelines we should map to the sign path

I'll loop in contracts and legal once we have the numbers to get the revised order form and an evidence package ready. Attaching the draft orderform we used in the call for quick reference.

Thanks —
Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Hi Sean —

Thanks — confirming a tentative uplift to 1.3x current committed capacity (we'll send the token/day numbers tomorrow morning). On audit notice: our security team prefers 60 days for SOC2 evidence requests so they can coordinate internal redaction reviews. Is that a firm blocker for you?

Procurement: we need the final order + signed MSA by Apr 15 to align with our quarter close; we plan to issue a PO within 2 business days of signature.

Greenridge Analytics

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift + MSA clarifications

Thanks for the quick reply — good to know on procurement timing. Olivia, 60 days for SOC2 is longer than our standard but we can accommodate with a small revision to the evidence access clause and a note in the order form about redaction timing.

Ben/Kim — can you take point on: (1) draft a short addendum that permits a 60-day notice for SOC2 evidence requests, and (2) confirm whether we need to reflect any pricing impact for the uplift or simply adjust committed capacity on the order form?

Laura — FYI on the planned uplift and the likely April 15 signature target. Can CS prepare a brief migration/traffic-shift window doc for the week after signature?

Sean

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift + MSA clarifications

Folks —

I've uploaded a redline of the MSA excerpt and a companion orderform mark-up. Key items:
1) Evidence / audit access — add a sentence to Section 7.4 to allow a 60-day notice for third-party SOC2 requests; customer-provided redaction window up to 14 days.
2) Data retention — defined a 90-day rolling cache retention for customer-managed KV prefixes; longer-term persistence remains customer responsibility.
3) Pricing for uplift — proposed approach: keep current per-token list rate, apply uplift volume discount at 25% for the incremental capacity tier (the orderform shows the breakpoints).

I've attached three files: Greenridge_SOW_v3.docx (SOW + scope), orderform_v2.xlsx (pricing tiers), and a redline PDF of the MSA snippet.

Ben
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift + MSA clarifications

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the 60-day callout. Two quick notes from legal:
- We'll prepare an addendum that amends Section 7.4 per Ben's language. Please confirm greenlighting of the 14-day redaction window (we can extend if your legal/security needs it).
- For audit logistics we will request a minimal set of artifacts (SOC2 report summary, control owner point-of-contact, and hash of transmission logs). If you have a standard evidence checklist, please share so we can minimize back-and-forth.

Olivia — would Greenridge be willing to accept a short "evidence handling" exhibit rather than changing the MSA body text? That would keep the core MSA unchanged and make the audit expectations explicit in the exhibit.

Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

3) Laura: CS to publish migration window doc and notify CS ops (target week: Apr 19).
4) Olivia: Greenridge will issue PO within 48 hours of signature.
